## Tone

Copy is direct, clinical and administrative.

- Errors state the problem and often the fix, e.g. "Please set Customer in Patient {0}", "Configure a service Item for {0}", "Price List is mandatory", "Registration Fee cannot be negative or zero".
- Use sentence-style messages with Title Case dialog titles, e.g. "Missing Configuration", "Customer Not Found", "Price List Not Set", "Mark Time as Unavailable".
- Child-table errors are prefixed `Row #{0}:`, e.g. "Row #{0}: Check Out datetime cannot be less than Check In datetime".
- Confirmations are questions, e.g. "Are you sure you want to mark this time as unavailable?". Progress messages use an ellipsis, e.g. "Checking for conflicts...".
- Buttons are verb-first in Title Case, e.g. "Check Conflicts".

## Terminology

Use the DocType names exactly as they appear in the product:

- Patient, Healthcare Practitioner (not "doctor"), Patient Appointment, Patient Encounter
- Healthcare Service Unit, Medical Department, Appointment Type, Fee Validity
- Inpatient Record, Lab Test, Clinical Procedure, Service Request, Observation
- Insurance Payor, Healthcare Settings

The product name is **Biograph**. A v16 patch rebranded the old name "Marley", so don't introduce "Marley" in new copy.

## Mechanics

- All strings must be translatable: `_()` in Python and `__()` in JS, with `{0}` positional placeholders, so Crowdin can pick them up from `main.pot`.
- Don't concatenate translated fragments, and don't put f-strings inside `_()`. A few legacy `_(f"...")` calls exist; don't copy them.
